bugs_found: transfer rejects same-currency transfers and allows cross-currency transfers because the currency check is inverted
transfer does not coerce/validate amount as Decimal, so float/string inputs can raise TypeError or mix types inconsistently while other functions normalize inputs
compound_interest and loan_payment silently truncate fractional years/months/compounds_per_year via int(), changing financial results without error
fx_convert accepts zero or negative FX rates from rates, allowing zero/negative converted amounts despite nonnegative input
money outputs are never quantized/rounded to currency minor units, causing fractional-cent balances/payments/fees to propagate
